Import your team

  1. In mGBA with the game running: Tools → Scripting…, then File → Load script… and pick soulgold_export.lua.
  2. Your party and PC boxes appear in the SoulGold sets tab (and in soulgold_sets.txt next to the script). They update as you play.
  3. Copy the text and paste it below, or load the .txt file.
